entries.title: A crewmate's answer ends the wait after its progress line
entries.body: When a crewmate posted a short line under your reply saying what it was working on, its real answer could be kept as a plain comment, so the card kept saying the crewmate had not answered and its task kept saying "A reply is queued". The answer now ends the wait. A card already stuck this way ends its wait with the crewmate's next answer.
entries.noPicture: The thread looks as it always should once answered; the fix removes a waiting line that stayed after the answer, which an after picture can show only by its absence.
